agreement.reason: one annotator labelled this sample, so there is no second set of labels to agree with. A single annotator scored against themselves is not a reliability figure

annotator_note: one annotator and it is an automated run reading each tile pair, recorded in the export as the annotator id. These labels are a worked example of the path from sortie to project to graded sample. They are not an expert ground truth and nothing in this release treats them as one
